items.stem: Which Word feature removes personal information and comments before sharing a document?

options.rationale: Correct: Document Inspector finds and removes personal data, comments and hidden content.
Track Changes records edits; it does not remove metadata.
Insert Caption labels figures; it does not remove data.
Mark as Final discourages editing but does not strip metadata.

items.explanation: Correct: Document Inspector finds and removes personal data, comments and hidden content.

items.stem: What should you insert so a document's heading styles generate an updatable contents list?

options.text: A table of contents built from heading styles
options.rationale: Correct: a table of contents built from heading styles can be updated automatically.

options.text: A manual bulleted list of headings
options.rationale: A manual list does not update when headings change.
A text box holds content but does not build a TOC.
A header/footer repeats content on pages; it is not a TOC.

items.explanation: Correct: a table of contents built from heading styles can be updated automatically.

items.stem: Select TWO actions that belong to managing document collaboration in Word.

options.rationale: Correct: adding and replying to comments is a collaboration task.
Correct: accepting or rejecting tracked changes is a collaboration task.
Cropping a picture is a graphic-element task.
Converting text to a table is a tables-and-lists task.

items.explanation: Correct keys: A, B. Correct: adding and replying to comments is a collaboration task.
